name: Concurrent Prolog
summary: Ehud Shapiro's committed-choice concurrent logic language with guarded clauses and read-only variable annotations for synchronisation, used to explore systems programming in logic and influential on ICOT's Fifth Generation project; later refined as Flat Concurrent Prolog.

level_notes.0: Shapiro's original interpreter (in Prolog) appears in ICOT TR-003 and the 1987 Collected Papers; no maintained implementation online.
level_notes.1: ICOT TR-003 'A Subset of Concurrent Prolog and its Interpreter' (1983) defines it; not freely linked.
